auth.motivational: Every day is a new chance for better health — start your journey with us.
auth.welcomeLoginBody: Clinical nutrition clinic — sign in to follow your food diary, plans, and subscriptions.
auth.welcomeRegisterBody: Create your account so we can calculate your daily energy needs and set your nutrition targets.
auth.forgotPasswordHint: Contact the clinic to reset your password.
auth.signInSubtitle: Sign in with your 11-digit phone number.
auth.asideSignInBody: Sign in to open today's diary, log foods by meal, and see calories and macros update in real time.
auth.asideRegisterBody: We calculate BMR and TDEE with the Mifflin-St Jeor equation, then set your daily calorie and macro targets.
auth.createAccountFooter: Create an account or sign in to continue.
auth.phoneHint: Phone number must be 11 digits starting with 07.
auth.passwordHint: Use exactly 4 characters: letters or digits (for example 12ab).
auth.invalidPassword: Password must be exactly 4 letters or digits.
auth.step1Subtitle: Step 1 of 3 — phone number and password.
auth.step2Subtitle: Step 2 of 3 — used to calculate your TDEE.
auth.step3Subtitle: Step 3 of 3 — review targets, then create your account.
auth.couldNotCalculate: Could not calculate TDEE. Check your details.

tdee.howSubtitle: A simple path from calculation to sustainable fat-loss progress.
tdee.step1Body: Use age, sex, weight, height, and activity to get maintenance calories.
tdee.step2Body: Choose a healthy deficit (often −500 kcal/day) for sustainable fat loss.
tdee.step3Body: Hit protein targets and fill the rest with balanced carbs and fats.
tdee.step4Body: Track meals on the dashboard and adjust if weight stalls for weeks.

subscriptions.unlockMeals: To unlock the weekly meal schedule (5 meals/day based on fat-loss calories), subscribe and confirm payment.
